entities.summary: Heinz Auerswald was a German lawyer and member of the Schutzstaffel (SS) in Nazi Germany, which he joined in 1933. In 1937 he became a member of the NSDAP. During World War II he served as the Commissioner of the Warsaw Ghetto.
